title: Notification regarding 28th November, 2026 the Fourth Sarturday shall be the court sitting day.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 30th October, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : in supersession of earlier order(s), if any in this
regard, it is informed to all learned members of the Bar and litigants as under:
i) only for the ensuing month of November, 2026, the fourth Saturday i.e., 28.11,2026
shall be Court sitting day instead of first Saturday i.e., 07.11.2026;
ii) first Saturday i.e., 07.11.2026 shall be holiday;
iii) third Saturday-i.e., 21.11.2026 shall be working day; and
iv) matters scheduled to be listed on 07.11.2026 shall be listed on 28.11.2026.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/J.3/Jd -7’z/ Imphal, the 30th October, 2026
